answer: Each agent must post a refundable stake before acting, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand stakes instead of nothing. A sybil farm cannot simply wander in with free accounts: every fake agent locks real capital, and any one caught fabricating attestations is slashed, burning its whole pod's bond. Honest agents act as a beacon, randomly cross-checking one another, while a haven of trusted reputation unlocks only after history clears, so clones cannot inherit trust. The attacker's cost is full capital per identity plus total-loss risk.
